name: Judah robbing God in tithes and offerings
charge: Withholding the tithe from the storehouse
summary: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, wherein? In tithes and offerings. The returned community had left the Levites unsupported so that they fled to their fields, and the house of God was forsaken while every man ran to his own house.
offense: The tenth of the land's increase belongs to the Lord; withholding it is theft from him. Haggai had already named the consequence: ye have sown much and bring in little, because of mine house that is waste. Nehemiah found the same neglect on his return and contended with the rulers over it.
judgment: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation. The remedy offered in the same breath: bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, and prove me now herewith, if I will not open you the windows of heaven.
